sources.title: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
sources.used_for: Re-read 2026-11-14. Link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near each affiliate link or review; the Operating Agreement statement must clearly and conspicuously appear on the Site.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (updated April 14, 2026)
sources.used_for: Re-read 2026-11-14 (page updated April 14, 2026). Commission Income Statement sections 1–2 (Qualifying Purchases, Qualifying Revenue, disqualified purchases incl. 2(c) paid search and 2(d)–(e) search and redirecting links); Standard Commission Income is in the Appendix, which links to the schedule URL (see S-SCHED). Participation Requirements sections 1(g) (trademark in domain or tag), 2(b) (prices and availability; Associates ID as parameter), 5 (no machine-learning use without approval), 6(e)–(f) (Amazon keywords), 6(g) (incentives), 6(p) (links in customer content), 6(s) (artificial clicks), 6(t) (reviews and star ratings), 6(w) (link shortening), 6(y), 6(z). IP License sections 2(k) (text disclaimer) and 4 (Agent Terms), re-read 2026-11-14 (F-23, F-24).
